content.text:
I didn't decide anything. I'll ask you first, and maybe the bank too. I'm fairly sure about that, because nothing on the page looked like my deposit. It's all shares, funds and English letters, and nowhere did it say whether any of it is as safe as a deposit.

**What I looked at, in order**
1. The big title "הראל". That name I know, so I stayed.
2. The line under it said "דמי הניהול הם הממוצע שנגבה בפועל ב־2025". So at least it talks about what they charge.
3. A row of buttons. "קופת גמל להשקעה 16" was already lit up. The others were "קרן השתלמות", "קרן חדשה מקיפה" and "חיסכון לכל ילד". That last one made me think of the grandchildren for a second.
4. A second row of buttons with "S&P 500" and "עוקב מדד מניות". English letters again. I nearly left there.
5. The big table, 16 lines. I read it from the right. I looked for the word אג"ח and found "אג"ח סחיר". But where the return should be it only says "פחות מ־3 שנים", with no number. So I don't know how it did.
6. "כספי (שקלי)" sounded safe. It shows "4.25%" for 3 years and "3.08%" for 5 years. I'm not sure what those numbers mean, maybe per year, maybe in total. The first number that stuck with me was "24.04%" next to "מניות". That's exactly the kind of thing that can fall.
7. Cost: "ההפקדה 0%" and "ההחיסכון 0.54%" up to "0.61%". At the bottom there was a pale line: "התקרה בחוק: 1.05% מהחיסכון, 4% מההפקדה". I understood that much. But I don't know what my bank takes from me, so I can't compare.
8. The second screen: more lines, then a list of closed sections. I didn't open any of them and stopped at "מה כתוב במסמכים של הראל".

**Words I didn't understand:** "S&P 500", "עוקב מדד", "גמיש", "סחיר", "כספי (שקלי)", "קרנות מחקות", "קרנות סל", "מרכזית לפיצויים", "מט"ח", "PF-10", "פחות מ־3 שנים". I also didn't understand "123 ממקור / מחושב / הזנה", and those coloured little circles I didn't even try to read.

**What I couldn't read or what bothered me:** the screen is black with grey writing. The small lines, like the ceiling line and the "בנוסף לדמי הניהול יורדות הוצאות ישירות…" line, were hard to read even enlarged. The table is crowded with numbers. Next to the returns it says "לפני דמי ניהול" and that the return "לא אומרת מה יקרה בהמשך". That worried me rather than helped. By the middle of the table I was already tired.
